name: Harvey Whitlock
role: Early elder sent to Missouri in 1831
dateNote: He was ordained a high priest on 4 June 1831; section 52 sends him to Missouri two days later.
importance: Section 52 sends him with David Whitmer to preach on the way to Missouri. Joseph Smith’s party met him at Chariton in August 1831 (62). He settled in Missouri and was driven from Jackson County in 1833. He was excommunicated by 1835, and his later life moved between several churches.
connections: His companion in section 52 was David Whitmer. He met Hyrum Smith and John Murdock at Chariton.

sources.title: Harvey Gilman Whitlock, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 1809, Massachusetts; physician; high priest 4 June 1831; expelled from Jackson County 1833; excommunicated by 1835; withdrew 1838; joined Rigdon’s church 1845, rebaptized 1858, joined the Reorganized Church c. 1860, excommunicated 1868; living in California in 1880. Death date and place not known.
